otherTracksConsidered.why: 15 Aug 2026 summited (summit 8 m), but starts 26.6 km and ends 27.4 km from our trailhead pin (a segment from an unknown start on the valley floor); not complete or trailhead-to-summit

facts.text: Mid-August: many black bears around the cirque below the peak; keep food in a canister at camp.
The massif has several tops of similar height; check against a map which is the named one before assuming a summit.

notes: Track starts at 615 m elevation far from our Dosewallips pin; likely a partial. No trailhead pin proposed (no confirmed page).
